archetypes.name: dyn-harness-parity
archetypes.rationale: Former Bash harness cases must retain exit-code and logging parity in pytest.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare python/tests/issue/test_file_oos.py disposition_gate cases to the assertion-parity map in skills/implement/scripts/test-oos-disposition-gate.md. Confirm gate skips, URL strict/loose rules, checkpoint NDJSON resolution, logging sites, and exit codes match the former harness. Flag any dropped Bash-only behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
